Read it slowly: bombs. On a bus. Disguised inside a teachers' protest. Eleven days before Mexico hosts the World Cup. Sheinbaum has been saying for a week the provocation isn't coming from the teachers — it's coming from groups who NEED a repression headline before the international cameras land. There's the smoking gun.
